newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish FLS wins Israel, US cement orders.
newsitem.headline: Danish FLS wins Israel, US cement orders.

text.p: Danish cement and engineering group FLS Industries said on Friday it won two orders totalling 510 million crowns for cement production lines in factories in Israel and the United States.
It said its U.S. subsidiary Fuller Company won the orders which were for an Ash Grove cement factory in Oregon and a Nesher Israel Cement Enterprises plant in Ramla.
The order covered modernisation of existing plants, equipment and new cement production lines, it said.
The U.S. order was worth 400 million crowns and the Israeli contract 110 million crowns, FLS said. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
